structures.core: Two rings in one molecule: a cyclohexane-1,3-dione on the left, drawn fully saturated with no ring C=C and no enol OH, joined through a ketone (C=O) bridge to a benzene ring on the right. The benzene is drawn as a hexagon with two vertical sides (vertices at top, upper-right, lower-right, bottom, lower-left, upper-left) with three inner Kekule lines. The cyclohexanedione ring is drawn in the same orientation.
substituents: cyclohexanedione ring: =O at C1, drawn as a double bond running straight up from the ring's top vertex to a capital O
cyclohexanedione ring: =O at C3, drawn as a double bond running down-right from the ring's lower-right vertex to a capital O

cyclohexanedione ring: the aroyl group C(=O)Ar at C2, i.e. at the upper-right ring vertex, which is the vertex lying between the two carbonyl-bearing vertices; the bond runs up-right to the bridging carbonyl carbon
cyclohexanedione ring: C4, C5 and C6 are bare vertices (CH2); no ring double bond and no OH is drawn anywhere in this ring
bridging carbonyl carbon: =O drawn straight up to a capital O; bonds down-left to cyclohexanedione C2 and down-right to benzene C1
benzene C1 (ipso, the upper-left vertex): the bridging C(=O) group
Cl at C2 (the benzene top vertex, adjacent to ipso going clockwise); label 'Cl' printed above the ring

CH2-O-CH2-CF3 at C3 (the benzene upper-right vertex); drawn out as a chain: bond up-right from the ring to a bare apex vertex (CH2), then down-right to a capital O, then up-right to a second bare apex vertex (CH2), then down-right to the printed label CF3 with a subscript 3
SO2CH3 at C4 (the benzene lower-right vertex); printed as the label SO2CH3 with subscript 2 and subscript 3, to the lower right of the ring
H at C5 (benzene bottom vertex) and H at C6 (benzene lower-left vertex); both drawn as bare vertices
benzene Kekule double bonds drawn as inner lines on C1=C2, C3=C4 and C5=C6
structures.name: 2-[2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoyl]cyclohexane-1,3-dione (tembotrione)

notes: THE ONLY DRAWN CHEMICAL STRUCTURE IN THE WHOLE PATENT. It is a lone standalone formula: no arrow, no reagent label, no condition, no numbering and no atom labels other than the heteroatom and group labels listed in substituents. HOW THE POSITIONS WERE OBTAINED: read off the drawing geometry at high magnification FIRST, and only afterwards compared with the printed name in [0002] and [0007]. The benzene hexagon has two vertical sides; the bond to the bridging ketone leaves the upper-left vertex, so that vertex is the ipso carbon C1. Going clockwise from it the vertices are top (Cl), upper-right (CH2OCH2CF3), lower-right (SO2CH3), bottom (bare) and lower-left (bare). That gives 2-Cl, 3-CH2OCH2CF3, 4-SO2CH3, which agrees with the printed name; the agreement is a check, not the source. Likewise the cyclohexanedione: the vertex carrying the aroyl bond has a carbonyl vertex immediately on either side of it, which is what makes it C2 of a 1,3-dione; that too was read from the drawing before the name was consulted. TAUTOMER: the left ring is drawn in the diketo (2-acyl-1,3-dione) form. No enol OH and no ring C=C is drawn, so C2 carries one implicit H as drawn. PRESENTED_AS: the enum has no value for 'the subject compound of the patent', which is what this is. 'invention_route' is recorded because this is the compound of the invention rather than a prior-art route, but the drawing is not a route at all: this patent discloses no synthesis and not one bond is formed or broken in it. Note the substance itself is prior art (known from WO 00/21924 per [0004]); what is claimed is its crystal modification. The same structure and the same SMILES appear at [0059] of the reference run runs/CN104292137A, reached there by an independent read; the two agree. The drawn structure is C17H16ClF3O6S, MW 440.82, counted from the drawing: 6 C + 2 O + 7 H (dione ring), 1 C + 1 O (bridge), 6 C + 2 H (arene), 1 C + 2 H (ArCH2), 1 O (ether), 1 C + 2 H (OCH2), 1 C + 3 F (CF3), 1 S + 2 O + 1 C + 3 H (SO2CH3). SMILES CROSS-CHECK: RDKit is not installed in this context, so the SMILES was verified by hand, atom by atom against the drawing, and by the formula count above; it was not machine-parsed here. build_enriched.py will canonicalise it and will report it if RDKit rejects it. DISCREPANCIES AND ILLEGIBLE ARE EMPTY AS A FINDING, NOT AS AN OMISSION: the drawn structure was compared substituent by substituent against both printed names on this page ([0002] and [0007]) and against the prose, and they agree on every position; and every glyph on the page is sharp and legible, this being a born-digital PDF, so there is nothing to record as [illegible].
